description: Source code for a dataset mapper class and related functions used in the DETR object detection framework within Detectron2, including image transformations, cropping, and annotation processing.

classes.name: DetrDatasetMapper
classes.description: A callable class that maps dataset entries into a format suitable for DETR, applying image transformations, cropping, and annotation processing.

methods.name: build_transform_gen
methods.description: Creates a list of image transformation generators based on configuration and training mode.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DetrDatasetMapper with configuration, setting up cropping, transformations, and image format.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Processes a dataset dictionary: reads image, applies transformations, cropping, converts to tensor, and processes annotations.
